A 17th-century pirate city slid into the sea in under two minutes. #ForgottenAndFound Divers still swim its intact street grid today, and the eyewitness accounts from that single morning in 1692 survive, written down within weeks of the earthquake that sank a third of Port Royal, Jamaica.

This video uses AI narration and AI-generated illustrations.

Sources: Wikipedia — "Port Royal" and "1692 Jamaica earthquake"; Texas A&M University Nautical Archaeology Program (Dr. Donny L. Hamilton's Port Royal excavation findings); UNESCO Jamaica Tentative List (2024) entry for the Submerged City of Port Royal; Jamaica National Heritage Trust; contemporary 1692 eyewitness accounts including Rev. Emmanuel Heath's letter, as preserved in historical secondary sources.

#ForgottenAndFound #PortRoyal #LostCities #PirateHistory #UnderwaterArchaeology
